style: Cheerful, juicy, slightly cartoony diner food illustration, like a picture book about a burger shop. Characters are friendly and round, never scary.

assets.name: bun-top
assets.prompt: ONLY the top half of a golden sesame seed hamburger bun, by itself: a soft rounded dome with sesame seeds and a flat cut edge underneath. No bottom bun, no burger, no fillings. Seen exactly from the side at eye level, as it looks stacked inside a burger: a wide, flat, horizontal layer, much wider than it is tall.

assets.name: boot
assets.prompt: A funny muddy old brown boot lying flat on its side, with a loose lace and a hole in the toe. Silly, not gross.

assets.name: bear
assets.prompt: A friendly round brown bear customer in a red striped shirt with a white napkin tucked in like a bib, sitting at a counter seen from the waist up, holding a fork in one paw and a knife in the other, smiling hungrily. Front view.

assets.name: bear-yum
assets.prompt: The same bear, from the waist up, eyes closed in delight, licking its lips, paws clasped happily, little hearts of joy.

assets.name: bear-yuck
assets.prompt: The same bear, from the waist up, grossed out: tongue out, eyes squeezed, holding its nose with one paw and pushing away with the other. Funny, not mean.

assets.name: bear-huh
assets.prompt: The same bear, from the waist up, confused: one eyebrow up, scratching its head with one paw, a puzzled little frown.

assets.name: diner
assets.prompt: Empty background: the inside of a cheerful retro diner. A long counter runs across the bottom of the picture, red stools, a checkered floor, warm lamps, a chrome kitchen pass-through window behind. A menu board with no words. No people, no animals, no food. 16:9.
